environment.description: Identical Celery worker on ECS Fargate. CloudFront distribution has a CloudFront Function (viewer-response trigger) that intercepts all HTML responses and injects integrity attributes on script tags by computing SHA-384 hashes against a pinned manifest stored in CloudFront KeyValueStore. Scripts whose src does not match a pre-registered origin (cdn.example.com with path prefix /analytics-v3, /widget-render-v2, /helpers-v1) have their tags rewritten to type='text/plain' with a data-blocked='integrity-mismatch' attribute. Additionally, the CloudFront response headers policy enforces Content-Security-Policy: script-src 'self' https://cdn.example.com 'strict-dynamic' with require-sri-for directives. The browser will refuse to execute any script tag lacking a valid integrity attribute matching the served content.

config.infrastructure: AWS ECS Fargate, internal ALB, API Gateway HTTP API, CloudFront distribution with viewer-response CloudFront Function
config.cloudfront_function: viewer-response trigger: iterates <script> tags, validates src against KeyValueStore pinned manifest (cdn.example.com/{analytics-v3,widget-render-v2,helpers-v1}.min.js), injects integrity='sha384-...' for known scripts, rewrites unknown src tags to type='text/plain' data-blocked='integrity-mismatch'
config.sri_enforcement: enforced via CloudFront Function + CSP require-sri-for
